$comment: Curated third-party Agent Skills. Nothing here is bundled with AIgile; entries are fetched from their source repositories on demand by `aigile skills:add`, and an ATTRIBUTION.md recording source, author, and license is written next to each downloaded skill. Review a skill before trusting it.

skills.title: Caveman
skills.description: Compressed, filler-free replies that keep code, commands, and errors byte-exact. Cuts output tokens.
skills.author: Julius Brussee

skills.title: Grill Me
skills.description: Interrogates your plan with hard questions before implementation starts. Pairs with the AIgile analyst and PO.
skills.author: Julius Brussee

skills.title: Junior to Senior
skills.description: Adversarial review pass over generated code to raise it to senior-level quality. Pairs with the AIgile dev and QA agents.
skills.author: Julius Brussee

skills.title: Loop Factory
skills.description: Spec-driven task loop (inbox to active to archive) for grinding through a backlog.
skills.author: Julius Brussee

skills.title: Context Canary
skills.description: Watches for context degradation in long sessions and prompts a reset before quality drops.
skills.author: Julius Brussee

skills.title: Interface Kit
skills.description: Practical UI construction guidance: looks good, loads fast, accessible. Pairs with the AIgile UI and UX experts.
skills.author: Julius Brussee

skills.title: Webapp Testing
skills.description: Drive and verify web applications in a real browser. Pairs with the AIgile automation-tester agent.
skills.author: Anthropic
skills.license: See repository (Apache-2.0 for most example skills)

skills.title: MCP Builder
skills.description: Build and package MCP servers. Useful when extending AIgile's MCP wiring.
skills.author: Anthropic
